title: Device Fingerprinting Policy Template
metaDescription: Create a comprehensive device fingerprinting policy for your website. Template covers collection practices, user rights, and privacy protections.
description: A comprehensive template for creating device fingerprinting policies that comply with privacy regulations. Covers data collection practices, user consent, retention policies, and protection measures for browser and device identification techniques.

sections.heading: What is Device Fingerprinting
sections.content:
Device fingerprinting is a technique used by {{COMPANY_NAME}} to collect information about your device and browser configuration for the purpose of {{PRIMARY_PURPOSE}}. This process creates a unique identifier based on characteristics such as:

• Browser type, version, and settings
• Operating system and version
• Screen resolution and color depth
• Installed fonts and plugins
• Time zone and language preferences
• Hardware specifications
• Canvas and WebGL rendering capabilities

Unlike cookies, device fingerprints cannot be easily deleted by users and may persist across browsing sessions.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content:
Through device fingerprinting, we may collect the following types of information:

**Technical Information:**
• Browser fingerprint data
• Device hardware characteristics
• Network configuration details
• Canvas fingerprinting data
• Audio context fingerprinting

**Usage Information:**
• Page interaction patterns
• Mouse movement and click patterns
• Typing cadence and behavior
• Navigation patterns

**Environmental Data:**
• Time zone and system time
• Language and locale settings
• Screen and window dimensions

We do not collect {{EXCLUDED_DATA}} through our fingerprinting techniques.

sections.heading: How We Use Fingerprinting Data
sections.content:
{{COMPANY_NAME}} uses device fingerprinting data for the following purposes:

**Primary Uses:**
• {{USE_CASE_1}}
• {{USE_CASE_2}}
• {{USE_CASE_3}}

**Security and Fraud Prevention:**
• Detecting suspicious or fraudulent activity
• Preventing unauthorized access
• Identifying bot traffic and automated attacks
• Maintaining account security

**Analytics and Improvement:**
• Understanding user behavior patterns
• Improving website performance
• Personalizing user experience
• Measuring advertising effectiveness

We do not sell fingerprinting data to third parties or use it for purposes other than those disclosed in this policy.

sections.heading: User Rights and Choices
sections.content:
While device fingerprinting is more difficult to control than traditional cookies, you have the following rights and options:

**Browser-Level Protection:**
• Use privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser that include fingerprint protection
• Enable strict privacy settings in your browser
• Use browser extensions that block fingerprinting scripts
• Regularly clear browser data and reset settings

**Your Rights:**
• Right to know what fingerprinting data we collect
• Right to request deletion of fingerprinting profiles
• Right to opt-out where technically feasible
• Right to receive information about data sharing

**Contact Us:**
To exercise your rights regarding device fingerprinting, contact us at {{CONTACT_EMAIL}} or through our privacy request form at {{PRIVACY_URL}}.

**Technical Limitations:**
Please note that completely preventing device fingerprinting may affect website functionality and security features.

sections.heading: Data Retention and Security
sections.content:
**Retention Period:**
We retain device fingerprinting data for {{RETENTION_PERIOD}} or until the purpose for collection is fulfilled, whichever is shorter. Data used for fraud prevention may be retained longer as required by law.

**Security Measures:**
• Encryption of fingerprinting data in transit and at rest
• Access controls limiting who can view fingerprinting data
• Regular security audits and monitoring
• Secure deletion procedures for expired data

**Data Sharing:**
We may share anonymized fingerprinting data with:
• {{SHARING_PARTY_1}}
• {{SHARING_PARTY_2}}
• Law enforcement when legally required

We do not share raw fingerprinting data with third parties for marketing purposes.

**International Transfers:**
If we transfer fingerprinting data internationally, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your privacy rights.
